🧠 Oasis Recommendation Lens — Real Work Considerations

✅ When Chrome Gemini Is Better

  • Enterprise-managed Chrome environment
  • Need centralized admin governance
  • Lower extension attack surface
  • Context-aware page summarization
  • Seamless UI integration

Limitation:

  • Ecosystem lock-in (Google Workspace)
  • Less flexible model choice
  • Limited plugin ecosystem integration

✅ When AI Extensions Are Better

  • Need model diversity (Claude, GPT-4.5, Perplexity, etc.)
  • Custom prompt engineering workflows
  • Advanced integrations with SaaS tools
  • Rapid experimentation

Limitation:

  • Extension security risk
  • Permission sprawl
  • Potential compliance gaps
  • Breakage after Chrome updates

⚠ Core Problems & Tradeoffs

  • Security Surface Area — Extensions increase attack surface; native AI reduces plugin risk but centralizes data.
  • Governance & DLP — Native AI integrates with admin controls; extensions may bypass enterprise monitoring.
  • Workflow Depth vs Simplicity — Extensions often more powerful; Gemini more frictionless.
  • Vendor Lock-In — Gemini locks to Google ecosystem; extensions allow multi-model use.
  • Reliability & Updates — Extensions may break with browser changes; native AI more stable.
